title: Pilot programs
intro: We're looking for organisations in Montréal that want to test transparent winter walking information with their communities.

items.title: Universities
items.body: Students and staff crossing a downtown campus in winter.

items.title: Campuses
items.body: Hospitals, colleges and corporate campuses with many building entrances.

items.title: Municipalities
items.body: Mobility teams who want aggregated insight into pedestrian winter barriers.

items.title: Property managers
items.body: Owners and managers who want to see reported issues around their buildings.

includes.title: What a pilot includes
items: A defined coverage area with its pedestrian network built and checked for gaps.
The bilingual route planner, configured for your area.
A moderated community-report channel for your users.
A written report of what worked and what didn't, using only measured results.

analytics.title: Privacy-respecting analytics
analytics.body: Pilot analytics are aggregated only: counts of route requests and reports per coarse area and day. No individual trips, no tracking, and no personal data is shared with partners.

honesty: We don't have published pilot results yet. We'll share measured outcomes, not projections.

form.title: Request a pilot conversation
form.consent: I agree that WinterPath may keep these details for 12 months to respond to this request.
form.success: Thank you — we've received your request.
form.consentRequired: You need to agree before sending.
